answer: To stop fakes, each identity crafts one unique artifact for 45 credits and files it at the jetty for a 40 fee, locking a 70-credit bond; the artifact bears a single-use ember seal and rests in the public haven registry. A copied or resold artifact fails the seal check and burns the bond. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x (45 + 40) = 85,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, reclaims its 70 after a clean epoch.
